Package br.edu.unipampa.varzinho.domain.capture

Class PtzCamera

java.lang.Object
br.edu.unipampa.varzinho.domain.capture.Camera
br.edu.unipampa.varzinho.domain.capture.PtzCamera
All Implemented Interfaces:
Aimable
public final class PtzCamera extends Camera implements Aimable
A camera that can be panned, tilted and zoomed.

Where it is pointing is part of what it captured, so the clip it produces is named after its aim as well as its id — two clips taken at the same second from the same camera looking elsewhere are not the same footage.

      public PtzCamera(String id, String model, Resolution resolution, int bufferSeconds)
      Builds a PTZ camera, switched off, at its rest position: pan 0, tilt 0, zoom 1.
      Parameters:
      id - the identifier, unique across the gym the camera is installed in
      model - the make and model of the equipment
      resolution - the resolution it records at
      bufferSeconds - how many of the most recent seconds the camera keeps
      Throws:
      IllegalArgumentException - if the id or model is missing or blank, the resolution is missing, or the buffer is not at least one second long

      Aims the camera. The ranges are the ones a domo head physically reaches: a full turn of pan, a quarter turn of tilt each way, and ten steps of zoom.

    • captureLastSeconds

      public VideoClip captureLastSeconds(int seconds)
      Description copied from class: Camera
      Freezes the most recent seconds into a clip. Each kind of camera produces one its own way, and a court triggers them all through this single call.

      Every kind keeps one promise: the clip is finished when this returns. A kind that writes a file has written it, so whoever holds the clip may archive it at once, without knowing which kind of camera cut it.

      Specified by:
      captureLastSeconds in class Camera
      Parameters:
      seconds - how much of the recent past to keep
      Returns:
      the finished clip that stands for those seconds
